parameters.content:
## 1. Start a run
Run Now is a POST webhook that needs the X-Run-Secret header. Send {"dryRun": true} to see who would be texted. The hourly schedule only runs when SCHEDULE_ENABLED is true. Both check the settings first, and a Run Now call with a missing setting gets a 500 that names it.

## 2. Find dormant leads
Searches GoHighLevel for leads with the reactivation tag or no activity for DORMANT_DAYS, without DND or the sent tag. Every rule is checked again in code, then the batch is capped at BATCH_LIMIT.

## 3. Text each lead
One lead at a time: reload the contact, check DND, tags and quiet hours in their own time zone, tag first, then send the SMS and wait SEND_DELAY_SECONDS. The tag is what stops anyone from being texted twice.

## 4. Run report
Posts a summary to Slack. If any text failed, the run ends as failed so the error workflow alerts you.

## 5. Receive a reply
A GoHighLevel workflow (Customer Replied, SMS) calls this webhook with the shared secret. Only SMS replies from campaign leads are handled, and a repeat delivery of the same message is skipped.

## 6. Decide
STOP words are handled in code before any AI. Everything else goes to Claude, which picks one intent through a forced tool call: interested, picked a time, question, not now, wrong person or stop. If Claude fails, the lead gets a holding reply.

## 7. Act
Opt outs get SMS DND. Interested leads get 3 real open times from the calendar. A picked time is booked and an open or lost opportunity moves to the booked stage. A won one is never reopened.

## 8. Reply and record
Adds the outcome tags, sends the SMS, posts a Slack alert when a person is needed or a lead booked, and ends the run as failed if anything went wrong.
